intro: Class data aur behaviour ko ek naam ke neeche baandhti hai. Is section me object banana, __init__ se state set karna, methods se behaviour dena, inheritance se reuse karna aur property/dataclass se readable API banana cover hota hai.
theory: Class blueprint hai, instance us blueprint se bana object. `self` current instance ka reference hai — isliye method same class ke do objects par alag data dekhta hai.
__init__ constructor hai jo naya object banne par chalta hai. Instance attributes self par set hote hain; class attributes sab instances me shared hote hain.
Inheritance `class Child(Parent)` se hoti hai; `super().__init__()` parent ka setup chalata hai. Method overriding se child apna behaviour de sakta hai.
Property getter/setter ko attribute jaisa banati hai, isliye validation ke saath `obj.value` readable rehta hai. dataclass __init__, __repr__ aur comparison free me deta hai.
Composition (object ke andar doosra object) inheritance se zyada flexible hota hai jab relationship "has-a" ho; inheritance "is-a" ke liye rakho.

explain: Same method naam alag classes me alag behaviour deta hai — caller ko type ki zaroorat nahi.
Output ko print se verify karo.
Ye OOP (Object Oriented Programming) ka basic building block hai.
Property attribute jaisa access deti hai par setter me validation chalati hai.
Ek step aur jodne se behaviour kaise badalta hai, dekho.
Input badal kar edge case test karo.
Domain exception class business rule ko naam deti hai aur caller ko specific handling deti hai.
Ye snippet end-to-end flow dikhata hai.
Output ko project/interview me evidence ki tarah use karo.

realWorld: Payment, order aur user jaise domain objects par validation aur behaviour class me rakhi jati hai, taaki har caller ko rules dobara na likhne padein.
SDK aur library APIs classes se banti hain: client object connection/config rakhta hai aur methods operations expose karte hain.
Dataclasses config aur DTOs ke liye standard hain — free repr se logs readable hote hain aur field mismatch jaldi pakda jata hai.

interview.q: Class attribute aur instance attribute me fark batao.
interview.a: Class attribute class par define hota hai aur sab instances share karte hain; instance attribute self par set hota hai aur har object ka apna hota hai. Immutable class attribute safe hai, mutable (list) shared hone se bugs aate hain.

interview.q: __init__ aur __new__ me kya antar hai?
interview.a: __new__ object banata hai, __init__ us object ko initialise karta hai. Normal classes me __init__ kaafi hai; immutable subclass ya singleton jaisi cheezon me __new__ chahiye hota hai.

interview.q: Inheritance kab avoid karna chahiye?
interview.a: Jab relationship "is-a" na ho. Deep hierarchies fragile hoti hain; composition (has-a) se code zyada flexible aur testable rehta hai.

interview.q: Property kyun use karte hain, simple attribute kyun nahi?
interview.a: Property se validation, computed values aur API compatibility milti hai bina caller ka syntax badle. Simple data ke liye plain attribute hi theek hai.

debugging.error: ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '12.5'
debugging.why: int() sirf poore number ka string parse karta hai. Ye OOP (Object Oriented Programming) ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: Pehle float() phir int() karo, ya Decimal use karo.
debugging.lesson: ValueError format ka issue hai, type ka nahi.

debugging.why: String immutable hai; append list ka method hai. Ye OOP (Object Oriented Programming) ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: String concatenation ya join use karo.
debugging.lesson: AttributeError galat type par method call ka signal hai.

debugging.why: Naam ki spelling galat hai; Python namespace me wo naam nahi milta. Ye OOP (Object Oriented Programming) ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: NameError typo ya missing assignment batata hai.

debugging.error: Logic error — sort() None return karta hai, list print nahi hoti
debugging.why: sort() in-place hai aur None deta hai, isliye print None dikhata hai. Ye OOP (Object Oriented Programming) ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: sorted() use karo ya pehle sort phir list print karo.
debugging.lesson: Mutating methods ka return value None hota hai — usse assign/print mat karo.
